name: Rice (White)
siboNotes: White rice is completely FODMAP-free and one of the safest starches for SIBO. All varieties (basmati, jasmine, arborio, sushi) are safe. Easy to digest and gentle on the gut.
preparationTips: Rinse before cooking for fluffier texture
All white rice varieties are safe
Use in stir-fries, bowls, and sides
Can be made into rice noodles
